text:
mira: Quick sync - NovaEdge wants a joint perf/W smoke + kernel tune trial. Need to confirm minimal metric set and who owns what.
ken: I can run the smoke and collect perf counters. Prefer seq lengths 128/512, batch 1/8.
olga: For kernel tuning we need their patch bundle and a reproducible workload. Can we ask for a portable kernel branch + build script?
bench-bot: Minimal telemetry suggestion:
``nnode_id
cpu_power_w
gpu_power_w
board_power_w
throughput_tokens_s
latency_ms_p95
thermal_package_c
kernel_commit
run_id
```
ops-sam: Capture BIOS, power cap, fan profile, and NV driver in run metadata. I'll reserve 1 bench node + 2 test nodes for the window.
nova_eng: We'll provide kernel branch via sftp and node_exporter metrics. Legal requested an NDA addendum for detailed power counters, sent yesterday.
mira: Proposed acceptance: throughput drop <= 10% vs baseline, perf/W change <= 6% after tune. Also track p99.
ken: Also include warm vs cold KV cache runs and automated reboot between experiments to reduce thermal noise.
olga: I'll adapt our bisect harness to their branch and run it in CI. Example: `./ci/bench --config edge-smoke.json --collect perfstat`
mira: Owners: mira - runbook + schedule, ken - bench execution, olga - kernel validation, ops-sam - lab ops, nova_eng - partner assets.
ops-sam: Lab window proposed Thu 08:00 - Fri 16:00 PT. Reserving nodes now and will post node names.
bench-bot: Tagging suggestion: `partner=novaedge`, `run_type=smoke`, `kernel_commit=<sha>`
mira: I'll set up a 20m pre-run with NovaEdge Monday to confirm telemetry fields and EOD creds. Will post runbook link when ready.
